title: ECG-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Targeted Electrocardiogram Waveform Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2610.17718v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Electrocardiogram (ECG) models need supervision that targets evolving weaknesses and remains faithful to waveform evidence. We introduce ECG-RSI, a recursive self-improvement framework combining verified waveform synthesis with feedback-guided intervention search. Signal remeasurement verifies waveform edits; construction errors guide generator repair, while learner errors motivate interventions compared on a separate selection set. Across seven benchmarks, three rounds raise Qwen3.5-35B-A3B's mean question-answering accuracy from 34.57% to 56.04% and mean classification F1 from 24.27 to 34.03. Across the retained trajectory, the preferred supervision shifts from direct reinforcement to confusion-focused contrasts. Continued feedback correction yields diminishing external gains. These results motivate separating error diagnosis from intervention selection and checking whether gains on the feedback set transfer to independent benchmarks.

translated_title: ECG-RSI：通过针对性心电图波形演化实现递归自我改进
translated_abstract: 心电图模型需要能够针对不断演变的弱点、并忠实于波形证据的监督信号。我们提出ECG-RSI，一个将经过验证的波形合成与反馈引导的干预搜索相结合的递归自我改进框架。信号重测量用于验证波形编辑；构建错误指导生成器修复，而学习者的错误则触发在独立选择集上进行比较的干预措施。在七个基准测试上，三轮迭代将Qwen3.5-35B-A3B的平均问答准确率从34.57%提升至56.04%，平均分类F1分数从24.27提升至34.03。在保留的轨迹中，优选的监督方式从直接强化学习转向以混淆为核心的对比学习。持续的反馈修正带来的外部收益呈递减趋势。这些结果促使人们将错误诊断与干预选择相分离，并检验反馈集上的收益能否迁移到独立基准上。
tldr: 提出ECG-RSI递归自我改进框架，通过经验证的波形合成与反馈引导的干预搜索，三轮迭代将心电图模型的问答准确率从34.57%提升至56.04%、分类F1分数从24.27提升至34.03。
en_tdlr: ECG-RSI is a recursive self-improvement framework combining verified waveform synthesis with feedback-guided intervention search, which boosts ECG model QA accuracy from 34.57% to 56.04% and classification F1 from 24.27 to 34.03 over three rounds across seven benchmarks.
